# Game-Codex overlay for vendored gamedev skills

These engine-neutral skills are third-party references (see `LICENSE` and `NOTICE`). In Game-Codex they are subordinate to root `AGENTS.md` and `child-first-learning-game`:

- `game-feel`: screen shake, hit-stop, flashes and strong knockback must respect reduced motion, stay optional, and never punish or startle; prefer gentle, readable feedback.
- `puzzle`: scoring may give local feedback only; no leaderboards, global comparison, streaks or punitive score loss.
- `save-systems`: local, anonymous, minimum-necessary state only; no accounts or cloud child profiles.
- `audio-design`: audio is optional and never the only feedback channel.
- `level-design` / `prototype-fast`: a prototype "is it fun?" check is a machine/adult judgement, not observed child fun.

When a vendor rule conflicts with these, the project rule wins.
